title: Frame after refreshing local variables
statement: For a list $l$ of integers, define its frame at index $i$ to be its entry at $i$, or $0$ if there is no such entry. Let $\mathrm{loc}:\mathbb N\to\mathbb Z$ agree with the frame of $l$ at every index outside a list $xs$. Then $\mathrm{loc}$ is exactly the frame of the list obtained by refreshing the entries of $l$ at the indices in $xs$ using the corresponding values of $\mathrm{loc}$.
hypotheses_covered: loc agrees with the frame of l at every y not in xs
